title: Updated Google privacy policy says your Gmail might be used for advertising
hook_text: Your Gmail is now ad data
script:
Google updated its privacy policy to allow ad targeting using your personal data.
Turning on the Personal Intelligence feature gives Google access to more information for targeted ads.
Data shared with AI search from connected apps can directly feed your ad profile.
Google specifies that Gmail messages can be utilized for advertising when this setting is active.
Would you keep Personal Intelligence turned on?
